title: Pre-weekly ops pulse + 1:1 prep (Ankur)
agenda_items: Metric snapshot (5m): 95th latency, tail errors, billing impact
Incidents & triage (10m): KV cache weirdness on long seqs, recent autoscaler flapping
Console rollout gating (10m): telemetry gaps, slow traces, canary health
Short-term priorities (10m): quant profiles for v1.3, batching policy tweak
Action review (5m): open items from last week + owners/dates
metrics_snapshot: tail error rate (5m): 0.45% spikes during 02:00–04:00 UTC
Autoscale down failures: 6 events in last 72h (nodes failed to drain)
Avg tokens/sec per GPU: 14.8 (batching burst late-evening)
Console trace sampling: 0.6% (need 1% for release gating)
discussion_notes:
Openers: remind Diego about the KV cache hypothesis doc (short link). Ask Maya about SLO vs SLI mismatches we saw on demo Friday. Triage plan: if KV cache bug reproduces on canary, rollback path = switch to uncached model variant + emergency autoscale to handle extra load. Need clear rollback steps in runbook.

KV cache: still seeing invalidation when sequences >24k tokens (probable pointer overwrite in LRU compaction). Lin to pair with runtime infra this week and try repro against long-seq harness. Put repro run in CI-perf lane (lower priority cards can be blocked).

Autoscaler: flapping appears tied to new node-image that delays kubelet registration by ~60s. Diego to open issue with infra image team and assign a rollout hold for node-image v2026-03-05. We should add a healthcheck that rejects draining until all pods report readiness.

Console rollout: telemetry sampling is too low for release gating. Short-term fix: bump sampling to 1% for canary namespace and add one-off dashboard showing per-request model variant. If traces still missing, fallback to synthetic traffic generator for 24h canary stress to exercise trace paths.

Prioritization: quant profiles for the 13B family should be landed before next cadence; otherwise cost delta will be higher than forecast. Consider a micro-canary for 13B-quant on Dedicated only.
action_items: AI-01: Lin - start KV cache repro harness + CI-perf job by 2026-03-18
AI-02: Diego - open infra ticket for node-image kubelet delay, add rollout hold, due 2026-03-13
AI-03: Maya - increase trace sampling to 1% for canary namespace and create temp dashboard, due 2026-03-12
AI-04: Ankur (me) - draft rollback steps for cached->uncached model variant switch and publish to runbook, due 2026-03-15
AI-05: Lin & Runtime Infra - evaluate 13B quant micro-canary on Dedicated with cost sim, due 2026-03-20
AI-06: Diego - add readiness gate for draining nodes to prevent autoscale down failures, due 2026-03-19
parking_lot: Longer-term: replace LRU compaction with pointer-safe arena allocator (research item)
Perf engineering: look at attention kernel selection heuristics for 4096+ context length workloads
Client SDK: add explicit hint for low-latency requests to bypass batching (product ask)
questions: Do we have capacity to run a 24h synthetic canary for console telemetry next week?
Is there appetite to move 13B workloads to Dedicated-only canary to reduce impact on Hosted billing?
Should we freeze node-image rollouts until the kubelet timing regression is investigated?
notes_to_self: Keep this lightweight in the meeting — focus on decisions not status. For 1:1, ask Maya about her bandwidth for pairing with Lin and whether she needs a direct ask to AE to pause a customer demo. After sync, update runbook with AI-04 and send summary + owner tags to #runtime-ops. Also mark AI-02 done in Jira when infra ticket is created.
